verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a deprecations policy, but it covers the model lifecycle (upgrades, redirects and deprecation schedules, including a 3-day notice before an endpoint redirects), not API-version deprecation. API versioning is only implied by the /v1/ path prefix and an OpenAPI document labeled version 2.0.0. missing for 10: a documented API versioning scheme and compatibility guarantees, a deprecation and sunset policy for API versions and endpoints (as opposed to models), longer notice windows, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Together AI follows a structured approach to introducing new models, upgrading existing models, and deprecating older versions, so you can rely on predictable behavior.
The current endpoint redirects to the upgraded version after a 3-day notice.
